description: Single-region world aggregate with source-backed 1900 total and provisional 1900 age/sex structure for M2.1 mechanics and total-population calibration. Not a source-verified 1900 age distribution.
notes: Initial total 1,621,287,278 is the OWID Jan 1, 1900 interpolation. Male/female age groups use the provisional 1900 age shares split by WPP 1950 age-specific sex shares; this is a documented projection assumption, not a 1900 source. WPP age/sex reference is separate. P4 (D-142): the block starts from the 1900 world levels of the province world, population-weighted from historical/p4/demography_1900.json (TFR 5.52, life expectancy 34.6, under-5 mortality 399 per 1,000; urban share 16.6% from HYDE 3.3). A population-only world has no countries, no education and no market, so these levels only move through food and child-mortality lag: it is not a historical projection.
